concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-capital-terms-of-service]] — 2026-09-15 Capital grant ToS guide covering required document types, `adyenCapital` generation, authorized signer acceptance and acceptance-record readback before grant payout.
warnings: The guide says test status returns only adyenForPlatformsAdvanced despite an illustrative three-type response; live types follow the actual integration.
The webhook example concerns sendToTransferInstrument, not an observed Capital receiveGrants state.
ToS acceptance is required before grant payout and the page says it enables receiveGrants; it does not prove an offer, disbursement, bank receipt or a particular user's actual consent.
